name: agent-issues
description: Write, improve and split GitHub issues and agent task briefs that coding agents can implement without asking questions. Evidence-based rules: runnable done-checks, verified anchors, stop-and-flag triggers, self-contained vertical slices, and a threshold-gated cold-read review.

interface.shortDescription: Write issues that coding agents can finish
interface.longDescription: Turns a request into a self-contained, verifiable issue or agent brief: interviews for missing facts, verifies every pointer in the repo, states runnable done-checks and stop-and-flag triggers, splits oversized work into vertical slices, and runs a cold-read review when the risk or size warrants it.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent-issues to write an issue for this change.
Use $agent-issues to improve this issue so an agent can implement it.
Use $agent-issues to split this issue into vertical slices.
